source_school: Harvard College Dean of Students Office Staff
bio: I provide administrative support to the Associate Dean of Student Engagement and their respective team. I also assist with the overall management of the Dean of Students suite. I love spending time with my family, traveling, making others laugh, and looking fabulous while doing it! Students can reach out to me for assistance with a question and to setup meetings with the Student Engagement team. Area Student Engagement Role Central
